contours_to_region — 2D contour op

• Data kinds: contour → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "contours_to_region", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: gen_region_contour_xld (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

*The figure is the actual output on a synthetic 128×128 input. Left: input, right: output. Point clouds are drawn as a top-down scatter (brightness = z), 1-D series as a line plot, volumes as the maximum-intensity projection along z, videos as the middle frame, complex images as magnitude; return values that are not pictures are shown as the values themselves.*

Usage

Rasterizes XLD contours and converts them into a region. Equivalent to HALCON's `gen_region_contour_xld` (Create a region from an XLD contour.).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a が仕上げに掛ける膨張の反復回数を 1〜3（1 + int(2a)）に振る。b` は未使用。輪郭点の実数座標を最近傍の画素へ丸めてマスクを立て、点間が疎で線がつながらないぶんを膨張で補う（サブピクセル精度は失われる）。
